source_read_findings.detail: Contain uses physical face coordinates, then maps the rectangle to integer canvas coordinates. Height rounding is compensated by separate canvas/world scale factors. sourceDisplay is a useful diagnostic, but the acceptance must derive actual bound face geometry and canvas pixels independently.

At this read snapshot only PANEL.server supplies surfaceAspect=2.3/.735. hero, storage, tor, ib still pass undefined and therefore use the legacy source-sized canvas branch. All five need final source reread after integration; not a final-delivery bug claim.

PANEL is currently enabled by the complement of rack/chip/server modes, not an explicit view=legacy guard. Examples ?x=70, ?x=100 or ?node=part:ssd may enter the legacy branch without explicit view. If the adopted rule is explicit legacy only, final routing/fallback must avoid original-image requests and undefined-map crashes for these implicit states. Do not blindly change PANEL gating while leaving legacy geometry dereferencing absent handles.

Canvas resize deliberately dispatches texture.dispose() to invalidate allocated GPU storage while retaining the same CanvasTexture object. Count resize invalidations separately from terminal handle/pool disposal; only terminal repeated dispose must add zero events.
Latest reread adds disposed || state === disposed to retry. The terminal-handle restart path is now guarded statically; retain actual-public no-new-request/no-write lifecycle verification.

Latest reread clears active only when active===request, closing the stale-completion clobber. Superseding still leaves previous Image callbacks tracked until completion/pool cleanup; narrowly verify per-handle disposal during overlapping real requests detaches obsolete callbacks too, with no retained attempts or late writes. This is cleanup coverage, not a stale-publication claim after token guards.

Current failure branch restores configured fallback dimensions and drawFallback, removes sourceDisplay, marks upload. A retry failure after ready must now be checked for genuine procedural fallback instead of old image pixels; resize invalidation can occur on this reverse dimension change too.

New actual modal supplies five TA nav buttons, copied real CanvasTexture canvas, raw original PNG download and a real retry button. Use these real UI actions for per-item display/retry evidence. Latest page teardown explicitly calls panelSources.dispose(); runtime idempotence and no delayed repaint remain pending.
